name: IEEE Foundation - General Funding Requests
notes: Main competitive grant program for IEEE units/chapters. Has real amounts ($5K-$50K, up to $100K) and two fixed annual application cycles.

name: IEEE Foundation - Students & Young Professionals
notes: Directory of ~60 scholarships/grants/fellowships across societies. Amounts/deadlines usually NOT listed here - use to spot new named opportunities, then add their own page below once found.

name: IEEE Students - Funds and Awards
notes: High-level student funding categories, links to Student Awards Portal.

name: IEEE New Initiatives Program
notes: IEEE-wide Seed Grants and New Initiatives funding for larger internal projects.

name: IEEE Antennas & Propagation Society - Research and Travel Grants
notes: Society-specific research/travel grants, usually has concrete amounts and deadlines.

name: IEEE Region 6 - Funding Partnerships and Opportunities
notes: Regional funding opportunities (Region 6 = Western USA). NOTE: currently fails - server's TLS cert doesn't cover this hostname (real misconfiguration on their end).

name: IEEE HTB - Tech4Good Call for Proposals
notes: Main Tech4Good project grants for IEEE member teams doing humanitarian tech work. $2,500-$10,000 per project.

name: IEEE HTB - ComSoc & Tech4Good Communication for All
notes: Joint ComSoc/Tech4Good call for digital-divide/connectivity projects.

name: IEEE HTB - EDS & Tech4Good Call for Proposals
notes: Joint Electron Devices Society/Tech4Good call. $2,500-$10,000 per project.

name: IEEE HTB - Region 8 Tech Catalyst Program
notes: Project grants for SIGHT Groups in Region 8. $1,000-$5,000 per project.

name: IEEE HTB - Event Sponsorship
notes: Sponsorship funding for humanitarian-tech-focused IEEE events. Gold tier up to $5,000, Silver up to $2,500.

name: IEEE HTB - AP-S Tech for Impact Challenge
notes: Joint AP-S/Tech4Good disaster-response tech challenge. Up to $25,000.

name: IEEE Signal Processing Society - Scholarship Program
notes: SPS's flagship student scholarship (up to $7,000 over 3 years).

name: IEEE Signal Processing Society - Travel Grants
notes: Conference travel grants for student/developing-country authors.

name: IEEE Computer Society - Scholarships and Awards
notes: Merwin Scholarship, Larson Paper Contest, WEIGD Student Support Fund, chapter grants, etc.

name: IEEE Young Professionals - Event Funding
notes: STEP/Local Activity/Meet-Up funding tiers ($500-$1,500) for YP-aligned events.

name: IEEE Robotics and Automation Society - Member Support Program
notes: RAS travel grants (~$1,500) for student/developing-country members presenting at RAS conferences.

name: IEEE RAS - Support for Chapters
notes: RAS's equivalent of a chapter/membership-development fund (not literally named MDI like SPS, but same purpose): Chapter Start-Up Grant ($500) and Chapter Initiative Grant (up to $2,000), reviewed twice yearly (31 Jan / 31 May).

name: IEEE RAS - Technical Education Program (RAS-TEP)
notes: RAS's TEP/Seasonal Schools funding: Main Track (up to $25,000), Emerging Track and Practitioner Track (up to $10,000 each). Page also lists a long historical archive of past schools - extractor prompt is tuned to collapse that into just the 3 current tracks.

name: IEEE SPS - Organize Local Initiatives (Member Driven Initiatives)
notes: SPS's MDI program: up to $3,500 (in-person/hybrid) or $2,500 (virtual) for chapter-run seasonal schools, forums, and regional events.

name: IEEE SPS - Chapter Resources
notes: Covers 4 distinct SPS chapter funding lines in one page: Speaker Expenses ($3,500), Additional/coffee-break Chapter Support ($500), Student Branch Chapter Support ($500), and the Student Branch Chapter Growth Reward ($25/new member, up to $250).

name: IEEE SPS Day - Photo Contest
notes: Annual (2 June) SPS Day chapter photo contest - winning chapter gets $250 in additional chapter funding.

name: IEEE Power & Energy Society - Awards and Scholarships
notes: PES's own awards/scholarships hub (Scholarship Plus, Outstanding Student Scholarship, memorial scholarships, etc).

name: IEEE Communications Society - Awards
notes: ComSoc career/service awards plus education and STEM grant programs.

name: IEEE Computer Society - Emerging Technology Grants
notes: Up to $50,000 for innovative CS projects/programs/activities not otherwise covered. Deadline 15 June 2026.

name: IEEE CS TCSE - Broadening Participation
notes: Technical Council on Software Engineering's community broadening-participation grants ($1,500-$5,000 based on past awardees). 2026 call deadline 15 May.

name: IEEE Computer Society - Broadening Participation Fund
notes: CS-wide (not TCSE-specific) broadening-participation grants, $5,000-$15,000 range. Deadline 3 August 2026.

name: IEEE Computer Society - Chapter Funding
notes: Chapter Grants (Small up to $500, Medium $500-$1,000, Large $1,000-$2,000), plus Core Funding ($200 match) and Incentive Funding ($650/$300) for top-performing chapters. This is CS's version of the '$500 growth funding' - it's tiered by grant size, not a single named 'growth' program.
